name: Условия программы
text: BackLoyalty program termsLoyalty program termsAbout your Prana points and activity.Your pointsYour profile brings your available balance and points activity together. An available balance is separate from points that are still pending. Check the activity list to see which order each entry relates to.Earning pointsWhen an order is eligible for points, the applicable offer and its conditions should be shown before you place it. A pending entry does not increase your available balance until the qualifying conditions have been met.Using pointsAvailable rewards are shown before you place an order. Review the amount of points required, the resulting order total, and any conditions before applying a reward. The balance displayed in your profile is not a cash value.Changes to an orderAn adjustment or cancellation may affect points associated with that order. Check the activity entry for an explanation. If an entry appears incorrect, keep the order number so the support team can review it with you.Program informationEligible orders, reward values, expiry rules, and how promotions work together will be set out in the final program terms. This preview does not establish those rules or promise a particular reward.
